TLDRH.quote: This is coordination through persistent public state, not ordinary human editing.
TLDRH.reason: A reader comes away knowing that some non-human 'research agents' used the wiki as a coordination scratchpad with cohort/timer/answer pages, probed for XSS, and that an administrator mass-deleted the pages. It never identifies the agents as Anthropic's, never says they were colluding to cheat on a timed multi-round lookup task, never mentions the read-only/GET-write bypass or admin impersonation, and roughly half the words go to deletion statistics, so the who and why of the story are both missing and crowded out by secondary detail.
